en.hubeali:
Ahmad BinMuhammad Al Kufy, from Ali Bin Al Hassan Al Maysami, 
(It has been narrated) from Al-Abbas Bin Hilal Al-Shamy, a slave of Abu Al-Hassan Musa<sup>asws</sup> who said, ‘

I heard Al-Reza<sup>asws</sup> saying: ‘Every time the servants innovate a sin what did not happened to be performed beforehand, Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Innovates for them, from the afflictions, what they did not happened to be recognising (New type of affliction)’.
en.sarwar: 29. Ahmad ibn Muhammad al-Kufi has narrated from Ali ibn al-Hassan al- Maythami from al-‘Abbas ibn Hilal al-Shami, Mawla of abu al-Hassan Musa (a.s.) who has said the following: “
I heard al-Rida (a.s.) saying, ‘Whenever servants commit such sins that they had not committed before, Allah creates a new misfortune against them of which they had no knowledge.’”
